conditions.L: Identical fixed statement and P64 shared files plus frozen NumStability library.
conditions.N: Identical fixed statement and P64 shared files; no NumStability artifact.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p64_t2_G_stage_leaf_residual (fp : P64FPModel) (n : ℕ) ... : ∃ Ds Dn dw, three gamma bounds and the two block-row residual identities
formal_statement.plain_language: The G-stage south and north block residuals have an exact decomposition with bounds for two GE leaf solves and the rounded inter-block product.

informal_proof: Section 4.2 combines the two child-solve residuals with the rounded product relation, giving the block residual in equations (21)-(22).
informal_statement: At a G-stage node with Gaussian-elimination leaves, the south and north block residuals decompose into two bounded child-solve errors and the bounded rounded product error.
paper_version: September 1994 University of Maryland author preprint of the 1996 Math. Comp. article; preprint pages 1-26

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: Both exact private proofs compile without sorry/admit; N imports no NumStability.

source_locations.anchor: Algorithm 1: Gs and Gn recursive child solves; leaf systems use Gaussian elimination
rounded matrix product and Gaussian-elimination solve bounds, equations (5)-(8)
G-stage equations, product-error bound (20), and block residual (21)-(22)

tier_rationale: The exact L proof needs two distinct substantial frozen results: lu_solve_backward_error for both GE leaf solves and matVec_error_bound for the intervening rounded block product. N independently reconstructs forward substitution, backward substitution, their LU-solve composition, and rounded dot-product analysis; the combined block-row identities are source equations (21)-(22). N is over 1600 lines and L is under 200. Neither numerical error theorem is readily available in Mathlib.
